fee_notes: $50,000 for First Business; $30,000 for Subsequent Business. 50% veterans and women-owned business discounts available for first business. In last fiscal year, Initial Franchise Fee ranged from $10,000 to $50,000.
raw_excerpt: When you sign a Franchise Agreement for the first Tide Laundromat Business that you develop ("First Business"), you will pay an Initial Franchise Fee in the amount of $50,000. When you sign the Franchise Agreement for a subsequent Tide Laundromat Business that you develop ("Subsequent Business"), you will pay an Initial Franchise Fee in the amount of $30,000.
